name: VRP harvest — IV>RV spread, ATR-stop calm long (1h)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (same VRP thesis as the 4h harvest but at 1h with a shorter realized window and an ATR-scaled stop so the calm-window long sizes its risk to prevailing range rather than a fixed fraction): a wide IV-over-RV gap means the crypto options market is charging a fat variance risk premium — dealers are structurally short gamma to retail that overpays for convexity (Deribit 2025). We cannot short options, so we harvest the proxy: implied>>realized forecasts realized UNDERSHOOTS implied, so the coming hours are calmer-than-priced -> a spot long held into the calm, not a breakout. Entry: dvol clears a fitted floor (premium present) AND a short vol_realized window sits below a fitted ceiling (already calm) AND atr sits below a fitted ceiling (confirming low current range, an independent realized-vol gauge from the band z one). The counterparty is the option BUYER overpaying for tail insurance; we sell that fear patiently. Exit is an ATR-multiple stop plus TP/time so the position is sized to range. DISCONFIRMER 1: replace the two-legged IV>RV with dvol ALONE — if the level gate alone matches the deflated Sharpe, the spread is uninformative and this is a dvol-spike re-skin. DISCONFIRMER 2: if atr-ceiling and vol_realized-ceiling fire on the same bars >80% of the time they are one gauge, not two — drop one. HARD CAVEAT: ~148 DVOL points -> paper-only; the shorter 1h hold multiplies fee drag, so per-trade net edge must clear ~20bps round-trip or the trade count kills it.
catalyst: options pricing a premium into an already-calm low-range hour
